places.name: Pal Arinsal and Grandvalira ski areas

guide.buy: Tobacco, perfume, electronics, wine, spirits (check allowances).

guide.cost: High, but diverse; street food and Metro are cheaper.
guide.transport: Dubai Metro and tram, taxis, Careem, buses, Etihad Rail development.
guide.food: Shawarma, machboos, luqaimat, Emirati coffee, Levantine mezze.
guide.buy: Gold, spices, oud, dates, carpets.
guide.warn: Strict laws on alcohol, public behaviour and drugs; dress modestly in public; extreme summer heat; Ramadan etiquette.
guide.climate: Hot desert; best November to March.

guide.cost: Very low prices; services for visitors are almost non-existent.
guide.transport: Domestic flights; shared taxis and buses; road travel is risky.
guide.stay: A few hotels in Kabul and Herat.
guide.food: Kabuli pulao, mantu dumplings, kebabs, naan bread, green tea.
guide.buy: Carpets, lapis lazuli, handicrafts, dried fruit.
guide.warn: Most governments advise against all travel; check official advice before any plan.
guide.climate: Continental; hot summers, very cold winters.

guide.cost: High; resort prices apply.
guide.transport: Taxis, buses, rental cars (left-hand traffic), ferries to Barbuda.
guide.food: Fungee and pepperpot, ducana, grilled fish, rum punch.
guide.buy: Local pottery, hot sauces, rum, handwoven crafts.
guide.warn: Hurricane season June to November; strong sun; petty theft from unattended items; reef-safe sun cream.
guide.climate: Tropical; best December to April.

guide.cost: Very good value, especially food and coastal guesthouses.
guide.transport: Furgon minibuses, buses, ferries (Lake Koman), hire cars; roads are improving.
guide.food: Byrek, tavë kosi, fergese, grilled lamb, raki.
guide.buy: Raki, honey, handwoven rugs, olive oil, filigree silver.
guide.warn: Mountain roads and local driving habits; bring cash for rural areas; check advice on mined border zones.
guide.climate: Mediterranean coast, cold mountains; best May to June and September to October.

places.name: Khor Virap monastery with Mount Ararat views
Tatev Monastery and wings cable car

guide.cost: Good value; wine and food are affordable.
guide.transport: Marshrutka minibuses, taxis, ride-hailing in Yerevan, trains between a few cities.
guide.food: Khorovats barbecue, lavash bread, dolma, khash, Armenian brandy.
guide.buy: Brandy, dried apricots, carpets, ceramics, duduk instruments.
guide.warn: Check advice for border areas; mountain roads can be rough; altitude in the highlands.
guide.climate: Continental; best May to June and September to October.

guide.cost: Luanda is very expensive; elsewhere costs fall but visitor services are thin.
guide.transport: Domestic flights between cities; long-distance buses; taxis and minibuses in cities; roads can be rough.
guide.stay: Hotels in Luanda are pricey; lodges in national parks; basic guesthouses elsewhere.
guide.food: Muamba de galinha chicken stew, funge, grilled fish, calulu.
guide.buy: Wood carvings, masks, textiles, coffee.
guide.warn: Petty theft in Luanda; landmine areas remain in rural zones, so stay on known roads; malaria and yellow fever risk.
guide.climate: Tropical; dry season May to September is best.

places.name: Buenos Aires La Boca and Caminito

guide.cost: Good value, though inflation changes prices; check the exchange rates.
guide.transport: Long-distance buses, domestic flights, Buenos Aires Subte and colectivos, SUBE card.
guide.food: Asado grilled meat, empanadas, dulce de leche, mate, malbec wine.
guide.buy: Leather jackets, malbec wine, mate gourds, alfajores, wool goods.
guide.warn: Pickpockets and phone snatching in Buenos Aires; cash rates may differ; protests can block roads.
guide.climate: Varied; Patagonia summer is December to March.

guide.cost: High; markets and bakeries help.
guide.transport: ÖBB trains, Vienna U-Bahn and trams, buses; Vorteilscard and regional passes.
guide.food: Wiener schnitzel, Sachertorte, apple strudel, Kaiserschmarrn, goulash.
guide.buy: Chocolate, Mozart items, crystals, Loden clothing, Alpine pumpkin seed oil.
guide.warn: Highway toll vignette needed for cars; Alpine weather and avalanche risk; Sunday shop closures.
guide.climate: Continental Alpine; summer hiking, winter skiing.

places.name: Museum of Old and New Art Hobart

guide.cost: High; distances are long and tipping is not expected.
guide.transport: Domestic flights, trains (Indian Pacific), metros and trams in cities, Uber, car and campervan hire (left-hand traffic).
guide.stay: Hotels, motels, hostels, caravan parks, outback stations.
guide.food: Meat pies, barbecue, Vegemite, flat whites, lamingtons, fresh seafood.
guide.buy: Opals, Aboriginal art (buy from ethical sources), Ugg boots, wool, wine.
guide.warn: Strong sun and UV; dangerous marine life and crocodiles; rip currents (swim between flags); long remote drives; an electronic visa or authority is needed.
guide.climate: Varied; best spring and autumn, wet season in the north November to April.

guide.cost: Moderate; Baku costs more than regions.
guide.transport: Baku Metro and taxis, trains and buses between cities.
guide.stay: Hotels in Baku, guesthouses in Sheki, mountain lodges.
guide.food: Plov, dolma, qutab, piti stew, tea in armudu glasses.
guide.buy: Carpets, pomegranate products, tea sets, caviar from licensed shops.
guide.warn: Check advice for border regions; avoid photographing sensitive sites; e-visa needed for most.
guide.climate: Semi-arid; best spring and autumn.

guide.cost: Very cheap.
guide.transport: Buses between cities, trains on a few lines, taxis and car hire.
guide.food: Cevapi, burek, Bosnian coffee, baklava, klepe.
guide.buy: Copperware coffee sets, carpets, rakija, wood carvings.
guide.warn: Unexploded landmines remain in rural areas; stay on marked paths and paved roads; check advice for rural hiking.
guide.climate: Continental; best May to September.

guide.cost: High.
guide.transport: ZR minibuses, buses, taxis, rental cars (left-hand traffic).
guide.food: Flying fish with cou-cou, pudding and souse, fish cakes, rum punch.
guide.buy: Rum, local pottery, jewellery, sauces.
guide.warn: Hurricane season; strong Atlantic surf on the east coast; sun protection.
guide.climate: Tropical; best December to May.

guide.cost: Very cheap.
guide.transport: Rickshaws, CNG auto-rickshaws, trains, launches on rivers, buses, ride-hailing in Dhaka.
guide.stay: Budget hotels, guesthouses, resorts at Cox's Bazar.
guide.food: Biryani, hilsa fish, bhuna curries, panta bhat, mishti sweets.
guide.buy: Jamdani saris, jute goods, terracotta, tea.
guide.warn: Dhaka traffic is heavy; flooding in the monsoon; political demonstrations; pickpockets; drink bottled water.
guide.climate: Tropical monsoon; best November to February.

places.name: Ypres Menin Gate and In Flanders Fields Museum

guide.cost: High but varied; fries stands and bakeries are cheap.
guide.transport: Dense rail network (SNCB), trams and metros, bikes; Rail Pass options.
guide.food: Moules-frites, waffles, Belgian chocolate, stoofvlees, beer in hundreds of types.
guide.buy: Chocolate, lace, beer, comic books, diamonds in Antwerp.
guide.warn: Pickpockets at stations and Grand Place; rail strikes occur; check low emission zones for cars.
guide.climate: Temperate maritime; changeable weather, bring a rain layer.

guide.cost: Low prices; most things are cash.
guide.transport: Buses and shared taxis between towns; moto taxis in cities; roads outside main routes are poor.
guide.stay: Simple hotels in Ouagadougou and Bobo-Dioulasso.
guide.food: To millet porridge, riz gras, grilled chicken, bissap juice.
guide.buy: Bronze figures, leather goods, woven cloth, Bogolan mudcloth.
guide.warn: Security conditions are serious and many governments advise against travel to much of the country; check advice before planning.
guide.climate: Hot Sahel climate; cooler November to February.

places.name: Plovdiv Old Town and Roman Theatre

guide.cost: Very good value.
guide.transport: Trains, buses, Bolt taxis, Sofia metro, car hire.
guide.stay: Hotels, family guesthouses, mountain huts, Black Sea resorts.
guide.food: Banitsa, shopska salad, kavarma, kebapche, rakia.
guide.buy: Rose oil, embroidered textiles, rakia, yoghurt cultures, wine.
guide.warn: Taxi overcharging at stations; pickpockets on public transport; hiking safety in mountains.
guide.climate: Continental with Black Sea summers; best May to September.

guide.cost: Moderate to high.
guide.transport: Taxis, ride-hailing and car rental; causeway to Saudi Arabia.
guide.stay: Business and beach hotels in Manama.
guide.food: Machboos, muhammar sweet rice, shawarma, fresh seafood.
guide.buy: Pearls, gold jewellery, textiles, spices.
guide.warn: Strict local laws; modest dress in public; hot summers; respect religious customs.
guide.climate: Hot desert; best November to March.

places.name: Source of the Nile at Rutovu

guide.cost: Low costs, though few visitor services.
guide.transport: Shared minibuses and moto taxis; limited roads; boats on Lake Tanganyika.
guide.stay: Basic hotels in Bujumbura; lakeside guesthouses.
guide.food: Grilled brochettes, fried plantain, beans, lake fish.
guide.buy: Drums, baskets, wood carvings, coffee.
guide.warn: Political tension and border incidents occur; check current advice; malaria risk.
guide.climate: Tropical highlands; dry season June to August is best.

guide.cost: Very affordable; motorbike taxis are cheap.
guide.transport: Zémidjan motorbike taxis in cities; shared taxis and buses between towns; boats at Ganvie.
guide.stay: Budget hotels and eco-lodges; guesthouses near Pendjari park.
guide.food: Pounded yam with sauce, akassa, grilled fish, fried plantain.
guide.buy: Batik fabrics, voodoo-inspired art, brass work, baskets.
guide.warn: Malaria and yellow fever risk; bag snatching in Cotonou; avoid northern border areas; helmets are rarely provided on moto taxis.
guide.climate: Hot and humid; best November to February.

guide.cost: Moderate; alcohol is not sold.
guide.transport: Taxis, buses, water taxis in Kampong Ayer.
guide.stay: Hotels in Bandar Seri Begawan; jungle lodges at Temburong.
guide.food: Ambuyat sago dish, nasi katok, satay, kuih.
guide.buy: Songket textiles, brass cannons, silver ware.
guide.warn: Strict laws; modest dress; no alcohol in public; respect religious customs.
guide.climate: Equatorial; humid year-round.

places.name: Lake Titicaca and Isla del Sol
La Paz Witches' Market and cable cars

guide.cost: Very cheap.
guide.transport: Buses, minivans, domestic flights, the Uyuni tour 4x4s, La Paz cable cars.
guide.food: Salteñas, anticuchos, silpancho, llama steak, api morado, quinoa soup.
guide.buy: Alpaca knitwear, ponchos, Andean instruments, silver jewellery.
guide.warn: Altitude sickness in La Paz and Uyuni; check road and strike news; use authorised taxis; protests block roads.
guide.climate: Varied; dry season May to October.

places.name: Brasilia Cathedral and Oscar Niemeyer buildings

guide.cost: Moderate; costs vary by region.
guide.transport: Domestic flights, long-distance buses, metros in Rio and Sao Paulo, Uber and 99.
guide.food: Feijoada, pao de queijo, churrasco, acaraje, brigadeiros, caipirinha.
guide.buy: Havaianas flip-flops, Brazil nut products, cachaca, coffee, capoeira instruments.
guide.warn: Petty and violent crime in cities; avoid favelas without a guide; do not display valuables; sun and strong currents.
guide.climate: Mostly tropical; best April to October in many places.

guide.cost: Very high.
guide.transport: Taxis, jitney buses, ferries and domestic flights between islands.
guide.food: Conch salad, cracked conch, johnnycakes, guava duff, rum.
guide.buy: Straw goods, rum, Androsia batik, conch jewellery.
guide.warn: Hurricane season June to November; sharks and strong currents; crime in some areas of Nassau; sun protection.
guide.climate: Subtropical; best December to April.

guide.cost: A daily sustainable development fee for visitors applies; check the current rate.
guide.transport: Private cars with a guide; limited domestic flights; roads are winding.
guide.stay: Hotels and farmstays, usually arranged through licensed operators.
guide.food: Ema datshi chilli and cheese, red rice, momos, butter tea.
guide.buy: Thangka paintings, textiles, prayer wheels, handmade paper.
guide.warn: Visa and fees must be arranged in advance; altitude sickness at passes; roads can close in snow.
guide.climate: Mountain; best March to May and September to November.

guide.cost: Safaris and lodges are priced for high-value tourism; self-drive camping cuts costs.
guide.transport: Self-drive 4x4 or fly-in light aircraft for the Delta; buses between towns; taxis in Gaborone.
guide.stay: Safari lodges, tented camps and campsites; book months ahead for peak season.
guide.food: Seswaa shredded beef, pap porridge, mopane worms, braai grills.
guide.buy: Basketry, Kalahari crafts, leather goods, local art.
guide.warn: Wildlife is dangerous so follow guides; malaria in the north; drive carefully as animals cross roads at night.
guide.climate: Dry winters (May to October) are the best safari season; summers are hot and rainy.

places.name: Belarusian State Museum of the History of the Great Patriotic War

guide.cost: Moderate.
guide.transport: Metro in Minsk, trains, buses; visa rules and registration apply.
guide.food: Draniki potato pancakes, machanka, kholodnik, kvass.
guide.buy: Linen, amber jewellery, straw crafts, vodka.
guide.warn: Many governments advise against travel; border restrictions and political tension; check visa and entry rules and official advice.
guide.climate: Continental; warm summers, cold winters.

places.name: Cave tubing at Actun Tunichil Muknal

guide.cost: Moderate.
guide.transport: Buses, water taxis, domestic flights, rental cars.
guide.food: Rice and beans with stew chicken, fry jacks, ceviche, hudut stew.
guide.buy: Garifuna drums, slate carvings, hot sauce, local chocolate.
guide.warn: Crime in Belize City; reef and cave tours should use licensed guides; hurricane season.
guide.climate: Tropical; best December to April.

places.name: Banff National Park and Lake Louise

guide.cost: High; distances are large.
guide.transport: Domestic flights, VIA Rail, intercity buses, metros, car hire.
guide.food: Poutine, maple syrup treats, butter tarts, Montreal bagels, salmon.
guide.buy: Maple syrup, Inuit art (check authenticity), ice wine, outdoor gear.
guide.warn: Wildlife (bears) and weather; very cold winters; tipping 15-20 per cent is expected; an electronic travel authorisation may be needed.
guide.climate: Varied; summer for the Rockies, winter for skiing.

guide.cost: Costs are high in Kinshasa and Goma; park permits are pricey.
guide.transport: Boats on the Congo River; internal flights; poor roads; moto taxis.
guide.stay: Hotels in Kinshasa; lodges near gorilla parks.
guide.food: Moambe chicken, fufu, pondu cassava leaves, grilled tilapia.
guide.buy: Kuba cloth, masks, malachite crafts.
guide.warn: Armed conflict affects the east and Kasai regions; many governments advise against travel there; Ebola and cholera outbreaks happen; check advice.
guide.climate: Equatorial; dry season June to September in the south.

guide.cost: Costs are high for the limited services available.
guide.transport: Few paved roads; UN flights and charters; river boats where available.
guide.stay: Very limited hotels in Bangui; lodges near Dzanga-Sangha.
guide.food: Cassava, caterpillar stew, grilled fish, groundnut sauce.
guide.buy: Basketry, wood carvings, cloth.
guide.warn: Armed conflict makes travel extremely risky; most governments advise against all travel; check official advice.
guide.climate: Tropical; dry season December to March.

guide.cost: Expensive in Brazzaville and Pointe-Noire; parks are costly.
guide.transport: Flights to the north; trains Pointe-Noire to Brazzaville; river boats; shared taxis.
guide.stay: Hotels in cities; luxury camps in Odzala.
guide.food: Liboké fish in leaves, saka-saka cassava leaves, grilled plantain.
guide.buy: Poto-Poto paintings, wood carvings, raffia cloth.
guide.warn: Malaria and yellow fever risk; roads are poor in the rainy season; check advice for the Pool region.
guide.climate: Equatorial; dry season June to September.

guide.cost: Very high; supermarkets and half-fare cards help.
guide.transport: SBB trains, trams, buses, mountain railways, Swiss Travel Pass.
guide.food: Cheese fondue, raclette, rosti, chocolate, Basler Lackerli.
guide.buy: Swiss chocolate, watches, army knives, cuckoo clocks, cheese.
guide.warn: Quiet hours on Sundays; mountain weather and avalanche risk; cash and card both accepted.
guide.climate: Alpine; best June to September and December to March.

places.name: Atacama Desert and El Tatio geysers
Museo de la Memoria y los Derechos Humanos

guide.cost: Moderate to high; Patagonia costs more.
guide.transport: Buses, domestic flights, Santiago Metro, ferries in the south, car hire.
guide.food: Empanadas de pino, pastel de choclo, curanto, seafood, pisco sour, wine.
guide.buy: Lapis lazuli, copper items, wine, alpaca wool, Mapuche crafts.
guide.warn: Earthquakes and volcano activity; theft in Santiago and Valparaiso; check for protests; strong sun.
guide.climate: Varied; best November to March for Patagonia.

guide.cost: Moderate; city taxis are cheap but long road trips are slow.
guide.transport: Buses and shared taxis between cities; moto taxis; flights Douala to Yaounde; trains on the main line.
guide.stay: Hotels in Douala and Yaounde; beach hotels at Kribi and Limbe.
guide.food: Ndolé stew, poulet DG, grilled fish with plantain, koki.
guide.buy: Bamileke beadwork, wood carvings, Bamenda cloth, coffee.
guide.warn: Conflict in the Anglophone regions and Far North; many governments advise against travel there; carry ID; malaria risk.
guide.climate: Equatorial south, Sahelian north; November to February is driest.

guide.cost: Wide range; big cities cost more.
guide.transport: High-speed rail, metros, ride-hailing, domestic flights; Alipay and WeChat Pay are used widely.
guide.stay: Hotels at every level, hostels, traditional courtyard stays.
guide.food: Peking duck, dim sum, hot pot, mapo tofu, dumplings, noodles.
guide.buy: Silk, tea, jade, porcelain, calligraphy sets.
guide.warn: Many Western apps and sites are blocked; set up mobile payments before travel; carry your passport; check current visa-free rules.
guide.climate: Varied; spring and autumn are most comfortable in the north.

guide.cost: Good value.
guide.transport: Domestic flights, buses, Medellin Metro, Transmilenio in Bogota, Uber and InDrive.
guide.food: Bandeja paisa, arepas, ajiaco, empanadas, fresh fruit juices, coffee.
guide.buy: Coffee, emeralds, mochila bags, hats (sombrero vueltiao), Botero art prints.
guide.warn: Pickpockets and drink spiking in cities; do not accept strangers' drinks; check advice for border areas; altitude in Bogota.
guide.climate: Tropical, cooler in highlands; best December to March.

guide.cost: Moderate to high; park and tour fees add up.
guide.transport: Shuttle buses, public buses, domestic flights, rental cars, taxis.
guide.food: Gallo pinto, casado, ceviche, plantains, fresh fruit, coffee.
guide.buy: Coffee, wooden crafts, chorreador coffee makers, cocoa, tropical-wood items.
guide.warn: Rip currents; theft from parked cars; wildlife and snakes; rainy season landslides.
guide.climate: Tropical; dry season December to April.

places.name: Santiago de Cuba Castillo del Morro

guide.cost: Moderate; shortages and payment issues affect travellers.
guide.transport: Viazul buses, shared taxis, classic car taxis, domestic flights; fuel shortages.
guide.food: Ropa vieja, moros y cristianos rice and beans, tostones, mojito, rum.
guide.buy: Rum, cigars (buy from official shops), music, art, coffee.
guide.warn: Power cuts and shortages; bring cash because cards may not work; check entry rules and insurance; jineteros (touts).
guide.climate: Tropical; best November to April.

places.name: Sal salt flats and Santa Maria beach

guide.cost: Moderate; island ferries and flights add to costs.
guide.transport: Inter-island flights and ferries; aluguer shared vans on each island; walking trails.

guide.buy: Cape Verdean music CDs, handwoven cloth, local coffee and grogue.
guide.warn: Strong ocean currents and heavy surf; petty theft in Praia and Mindelo; sun protection essential.

guide.cost: Moderate; beach resorts cost more in summer.

guide.food: Halloumi, souvla, meze, koupepia, loukoumi sweets, commandaria wine.
guide.buy: Lefkara lace, halloumi, olive oil, ceramics, commandaria.
guide.warn: Driving on the left; strong sun; check rules for crossing the Green Line.
guide.climate: Mediterranean; best April to June and September to November.

places.name: Old Town Square and Astronomical Clock

guide.cost: Good value; beer is cheaper than water in many pubs.
guide.transport: Excellent trains and buses, Prague metro and trams, Bolt taxis.
guide.food: Svickova, goulash with dumplings, trdelnik, fried cheese, Pilsner beer.
guide.buy: Bohemian crystal, garnet jewellery, marionettes, Becherovka, beer.
guide.warn: Taxi and exchange-office scams in Prague; pickpockets on trams; validate tickets.
guide.climate: Continental; best May to September and December for markets.

guide.cost: Moderate to high; bakeries and markets are cheaper.
guide.transport: Deutsche Bahn ICE trains and the Deutschlandticket, U-Bahn and S-Bahn, buses, autobahn car travel.
guide.food: Bratwurst, pretzel, schnitzel, currywurst, black forest cake, beer.
guide.buy: Beer steins, cuckoo clocks, Christmas ornaments, Haribo, knives.
guide.warn: Cash is still common; shops are closed on Sundays; rail delays; respect quiet hours; recycling deposits.
guide.climate: Temperate; best May to September and December for markets.

guide.cost: One of the costlier African destinations.
guide.transport: Taxis; buses to Ali Sabieh and Tadjoura; ferries across the Gulf; 4x4 for the desert.
guide.stay: Hotels in Djibouti City; simple guesthouses in Tadjoura and Lake Abbe camps.
guide.food: Skoudehkaris spiced rice and lamb, fish, kebabs, camel milk.
guide.buy: Handwoven mats, local jewellery, frankincense.

guide.cost: Very high; supermarkets and bakeries save money.

guide.food: Smorrebrod, frikadeller, flaeskesteg, Danish pastry, hot dogs.

guide.climate: Temperate maritime; best May to September.

guide.cost: Moderate.
guide.transport: Minibuses, taxis, rental cars (left-hand traffic), hikes with guides.
guide.food: Callaloo soup, provision crops, saltfish, fresh fish, bush tea.

guide.cost: Moderate; all-inclusive resorts are common.
guide.transport: Guaguas minibuses, taxis, domestic flights, rental cars, Uber.

guide.buy: Rum, cigars, amber and larimar jewellery, coffee, cocoa.

places.name: National Museum of Antiquities and Islamic Arts

guide.cost: Prices are modest outside Algiers; tourist services are limited and cash is common.
guide.transport: Trains and buses link the north; domestic flights reach the Sahara; shared taxis and city metro in Algiers.

guide.food: Couscous, chorba soup, brik pastry, makroud sweets.
guide.buy: Tuareg silver jewellery, carpets, dates, copperware.
guide.warn: Check current official advice for Sahara and border regions; a visa is usually required; carry ID.

guide.cost: Very cheap; the Galapagos are much pricier.
guide.transport: Buses, domestic flights, Quito Metro, taxis, boats.
guide.food: Ceviche, locro de papa, fanesca, llapingachos, hornado, empanadas.
guide.buy: Panama hats, Otavalo textiles, tagua nut crafts, chocolate.
guide.warn: Security conditions changed; check advice for violence in some provinces and coastal cities; altitude in Quito; do not walk alone at night.

guide.cost: Moderate.
guide.transport: Buses, trains, Bolt, Tallinn trams, free public transport for residents.
guide.food: Black bread, sprats, verivorst blood sausage, kama, smoked fish.
guide.buy: Wool knitwear, amber, linen, marzipan, Vana Tallinn liqueur.
guide.warn: Pickpockets in Old Town; winter cold and ice; e-residency and digital services are common.
guide.climate: Continental; best June to August.

places.name: Red Sea reefs at Sharm el-Sheikh

guide.cost: Very good value; haggle for taxis and souvenirs.

guide.food: Koshari, ful medames, falafel (ta'amiya), molokhia, kebab.
guide.buy: Papyrus, alabaster, spices, cotton, perfumes.
guide.warn: Persistent touts and overcharging at tourist sites; check advice for northern Sinai; dress modestly; drink bottled water.
guide.climate: Hot desert; best October to April.

guide.cost: Moderate; cash only and limited ATMs.
guide.transport: Buses between towns need permits for some routes; taxis in Asmara; the Italian-built railway runs on some days.

guide.food: Injera with zigni stew, ful, grilled fish, Italian-style pasta and coffee.
guide.buy: Coffee, handwoven baskets, silver crosses, spices.
guide.warn: Travel permits are needed outside Asmara; photography of military sites is prohibited; check advice on borders.
guide.climate: Mild Asmara highlands, very hot coast.

guide.cost: Moderate; set lunch menus are good value.
guide.transport: Renfe and AVE high-speed trains, metros, buses, ferries to islands, car hire.
guide.food: Paella, tapas, jamon iberico, gazpacho, tortilla, churros.
guide.buy: Fans, ceramics, leather goods, olive oil, wine, saffron.
guide.warn: Pickpockets on metros and Las Ramblas; late dining hours; siestas close shops; heat in summer; bag snatching on scooters.
guide.climate: Mediterranean; best April to June and September to October.

places.name: National Museum of Ethiopia and Lucy
